text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open mixed-to-higher on Wednesday as markets absorb the Federal Reserve's increase in interest rates, analysts said.
They pointed to strong rises in European markets as an indicator of Wall Street's performance. Those markets shrugged off the hike in federal funds rate and pushed higher.
"I think we will see a market on the plus side with a strong opening and maybe profit-taking late in the day," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Securities.
